steps.title: Margins overlap inside one BFC
steps.titleZh: 同一个 BFC 里，外边距会重叠
steps.text: The first two squares both have `margin: 100px`, yet the gap between them is 100 px, not 200 px. Block boxes are laid out inside a block formatting context (BFC), and inside one BFC the top and bottom margins of neighbouring boxes overlap, or collapse.
steps.textZh: 前两个方块都设置了 `margin: 100px`，它们之间的间距却是 100 px，而不是 200 px。块级盒子在块级格式化上下文（BFC）里排列；在同一个 BFC 里，相邻盒子的上下外边距会重叠，也叫外边距折叠。

watch.label: gap between the first pair
watch.value: (() => { const [a, b] = document.querySelectorAll('.case-body1'); return Math.round(b.getBoundingClientRect().top - a.getBoundingClientRect().bottom) + ' px'; })()

steps.title: overflow: hidden keeps the margins apart
steps.titleZh: overflow: hidden 让外边距分开
steps.text: Each square of the second pair sits inside a `div` with `overflow: hidden`. That makes each `div` a BFC of its own, which keeps the square's margins inside it, so the gap is 200 px. Switch `overflow: hidden` off and on to watch the gap change.
steps.textZh: 第二组的每个方块都放在一个设置了 `overflow: hidden` 的 `div` 里。这让每个 `div` 自成一个 BFC，把方块的外边距留在里面，所以间距是 200 px。把 `overflow: hidden` 关掉再打开，看间距怎么变。
steps.actionLabel: Switch overflow: hidden off or on

watch.label: gap between the second pair
watch.value: (() => { const [a, b] = document.querySelectorAll('.case-body2 p'); return Math.round(b.getBoundingClientRect().top - a.getBoundingClientRect().bottom) + ' px'; })()

steps.title: box-sizing changes nothing here
steps.titleZh: 这里 box-sizing 不起作用
steps.text: `box-sizing: border-box` counts padding and border inside the `width`. These squares have neither, so they look exactly like the first pair, 100 px apart.
steps.textZh: `box-sizing: border-box` 会把内边距和边框算进 `width`。这组方块两者都没有，所以看起来和第一组完全一样，间距也是 100 px。

watch.label: gap between the third pair
watch.value: (() => { const [a, b] = document.querySelectorAll('.case-body3'); return Math.round(b.getBoundingClientRect().top - a.getBoundingClientRect().bottom) + ' px'; })()

steps.title: A BFC wraps around its floats
steps.titleZh: BFC 会包住里面的浮动元素
steps.text: The bordered box has `overflow: hidden`, so it grows around the floated square inside it. Switch it off: a float gives its parent no height, so the box shrinks to its 2 px of border.
steps.textZh: 带边框的盒子设置了 `overflow: hidden`，所以它会撑开，包住里面浮动的方块。把它关掉：浮动元素不会给父元素撑出高度，盒子就缩成只剩 2 px 的边框。
steps.actionLabel: Switch overflow: hidden off or on

steps.title: A BFC does not slide under a float
steps.titleZh: BFC 不会钻到浮动元素下面
steps.text: The grey box also has `overflow: hidden`, so it starts right next to the floated square. Switch it off: the grey box now starts under the float, at the same left edge, and only its text still flows around the square.
steps.textZh: 灰色盒子也设置了 `overflow: hidden`，所以它紧挨着浮动方块排列。把它关掉：灰色盒子会从浮动元素下面、同一个左边缘开始，只有里面的文字还绕着方块排。
steps.actionLabel: Switch overflow: hidden off or on

watch.label: grey box, from the float's left edge
watch.labelZh: 灰色盒子离浮动元素左边缘的距离

steps.title: display: flow-root does it on purpose
steps.titleZh: display: flow-root 专门做这件事
steps.text: `overflow: hidden` creates a BFC as a side effect, and can clip shadows or add scrollbars. The last box uses `display: flow-root`, which creates a BFC and does nothing else, so it holds its float with no clipping.
steps.textZh: `overflow: hidden` 创建 BFC 只是副作用，还可能裁掉阴影或出现滚动条。最后一个盒子用的是 `display: flow-root`：它只创建 BFC，别的什么也不做，所以能包住浮动元素而不裁剪任何内容。
